source: Carnegie Mellon University Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database
license: Free for commercial product inclusion; raw data may not be resold, including converted data.
acknowledgment: The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.
grounding: Per-frame pelvis-height correction places the lowest bare-foot sole at 3 mm above floor. Captured limb rotations and relative foot lift are retained.
method: ASF C M C-inverse forward kinematics, captured world orientation with anatomical rest-direction correction, target parent-relative rotation; continuous pelvis heading and ground travel extracted for actor movement. Right 180 is a sagittal mirror with swapped limbs.

turn_left_180.timing: Original 120 Hz sampling reduced to 30 Hz without speeding up.
turn_left_180.foot_curve_reference: Yaw-removed grounded target Foot.L/R bone heads, character-local Godot coordinates (+Z forward); samples at the same times as root_curve. Use sole_height_curve to identify the supporting foot.
